documentation_excerpts.text: Conductor is an open-source durable execution platform for microservices, AI agents, and adaptive workflow graphs. It turns runtime choices—loops, branching, fan-out, tool calls, approvals, retries, and cancellation—into durable, inspectable execution. It originated at [Netflix](https://netflixtechblog.com/netflix-conductor-a-microservices-orchestrator-2e8d4771bf40) and is actively maintained by [Orkes](https://orkes.io) and the [community](https://join.slack.com/t/orkes-conductor/shared_invite/
**Prerequisites:** [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) v16+ and Java 21+ must be installed.
